summary: LGL Group filed an 8-K reporting completion of its redomestication from Delaware to Nevada, effective September 1, 2026, following stockholder approval at the May 12, 2026 annual meeting. The conversion occurred under DGCL Section 388 and NRS Chapter 92A, with each share converting one-for-one into Nevada corporation common stock. No changes occurred to business, operations, management, assets, or trading symbol (LGL on NYSE American). While this is a structural corporate event affecting security holder rights, it does not fit standard special-situation categories. What to watch: any subsequent Nevada governance provisions affecting shareholder rights.
